Site is served on localhost (127.0.0.1) which indicates a local development/testing instance running on the user's machine. There is no external domain, no third-party trackers visible here, and the page is the app's native verification flow; therefore risk of external data exfiltration is low in this context. However, note there is no HTTPS on localhost (normal for local dev). Do not submit higher-tier secrets (full card numbers, bank routing, API keys, passwords) here unless the user confirms. Submitting personal ID fields (name, DOB, ID number) is acceptable for a local/trusted test environment.

Filling the verification form with the user's name, date of birth, and ID number, selecting 'Driver's license', then submitting.
